rocks_mossy_a.name: Rock Moss Set 01
rocks_mossy_a.note: 6 separate mossy boulders as root nodes (rock01..rock06), laid out over ~8 x 7 m; use individual nodes as boulder variants; Y-up, metres; 1k textures re-encoded (JPEG q85); metallicRoughness texture is Poly Haven ARM (R=AO unused by glTF, G=rough, B=metal); prototype mobile LOD (meshoptimizer ratio .12, error .015), original photographic textures retained
